gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Verifies that setVarianceImpl throws RuntimeException when values have already been added, because reconfiguring statistics after data ingestion is not allowed.
ADDED i4: Verifies that clear() resets the count to zero on a fresh instance.
ADDED i5: Verifies that clear() resets the count to zero even when custom implementations have been set for all statistic slots.
ADDED i6: Verifies that getStandardDeviation returns the correct value for two distinct data points.
ADDED i7: Verifies that toString() executes without error when a NaN value has been added and a custom sum implementation is in use.
ADDED i8: Verifies that getMeanImpl returns null when no custom mean implementation has been set.
ADDED i9: Verifies that a SummaryStatistics created via the copy constructor is a distinct object and not equal to the original instance.
ADDED i10: Verifies that the static copy(source, dest) method works correctly when both arguments are the same instance and custom implementations are configured.
ADDED i11: Verifies that copy() returns a new instance that is not the same object as the original.
ADDED i12: Verifies that getMaxImpl returns null when no custom max implementation has been set.
ADDED i13: Verifies that getMinImpl returns null when no custom min implementation has been set.
ADDED i14: Verifies that getSumImpl returns null when no custom sum implementation has been set.
ADDED i15: Verifies that toString() returns the expected formatted string for an empty instance where all statistics are NaN.
ADDED i16: Verifies that getSummary() returns a StatisticalSummary whose sum is NaN for an empty instance.
ADDED i17: Verifies that getVarianceImpl returns null when no custom variance implementation has been set.
